key_insight: MentalHospital is a virtual benchmark that tests LLMs across a full psychiatric encounter, not just isolated tasks.
clinical_relevance: It gives researchers a more realistic way to evaluate whether models can support psychiatric interviews, assessment, diagnosis, and treatment planning.
method: Built a SOAP-style virtual environment using skill-augmented standardized patients from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric EHR cases.
Covers all major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders.
Uses a dual-track evaluation: objective comparison to EHR references plus subjective review of clinical process quality.
evidence_signal: MentalEval reached strong expert alignment (average QWK 0.944), and the best LLM still lagged clinicians by 37.28 percentage points in objective psychiatric competence.
watch_item: The benchmark depends on simulated encounters and evaluator models, so real-world clinical performance and safety still need separate validation.
paper_title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
